examples.text: Нет, шеф, я сегодня вообще к печи не подходил.

examples.text: Подожди, я сейчас.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'else/more', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'where', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Костя, подожди минуту, тут возникла небольшая проблема.
